entities.summary: Alexei Pawlowitsch Schipenko (b. 1961-10-03, Sevastopol) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sevastopol. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
